FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF DELHI : NEW DELHI
DELHI HIGHER JUDICIAL SERVICE EXAMINATION - 2026
Dated: 08.10.2026
NOTICE
It is notified to all concerned that the Delhi Higher Judicial Service Mains
Examination (Written) - 2026, scheduled to be held on 10.10.2026 and
11.10.2026, has been postponed at the request of the Commissioner of Police,
Delhi. The Examination scheduled to be held on 10.10.2026 and 11.10.2026 will
now be held on Thursday, 22.10.2026 and Friday,
Revised Admit Cards will be issued to the candidates.
23.10.2026 respectively.
J~<L(Reetesh Singh)
Registrar General
